name: E7-Campus-Indoor
title: Access Point E7 Campus Indoor
summary: Directional 10-stream WiFi 7 AP for wall/pole mounting in large indoor venues; 10GbE + redundant 1GbE.

requires: 10GbE switch port to use full throughput
UniFi OS console / gateway running UniFi Network (10.0.162+)

gotchas: Needs PoE++ (44W max) — PoE+ switches like USW-Pro-8/24-PoE PoE+ ports won't run it; use PoE++ ports or a USW-Pro-Max/ECS PoE++ switch.
Antenna is directional (90°x50°) for wall/pole aiming at a seating area — for normal ceiling omni coverage pick U7 Pro / U7 Pro Max.
To use its 11.5 Gbps 6 GHz radio you need a 10GbE switch port (e.g. USW-Pro-XG-24 class); on 1GbE it's starved.
Indoor-rated (no IP rating) despite pole mounts — outdoor venues need the outdoor E7 Campus variant.
FCC/IC certified only; 6 GHz Extended Range is North America only.
